g.data-font-note: Original CORE title is outlined path data; the source font is not embedded. This title is newly typeset from Oswald variable @ wght 700, converted to glyph paths, then drawn as the SAME path twice (black stroke, then white fill). Layout STAMPLC is fitted to the original CORE title slot [42.207, 190.863, 110.863, 215.346]. Oswald is a substitute face, not a glyph-accurate match to CORE.
